name: Tomato Scrambled Eggs
steps: Dice the tomato. Heat the oil in a pan and soften the tomato. Beat the eggs, add to the pan and stir until fully set.

name: Simple Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs. Warm the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the eggs and cook until fully set, folding before serving.

name: Cheese Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs. Heat the oil, add eggs and grated cheese. Cook until fully set, then fold.

name: Potato and Onion Skillet
steps: Wash and finely dice potatoes and onion. Heat oil, add potatoes and cook gently, stirring often. Add onion and continue until potatoes are tender.

name: Tomato Toast
steps: Toast bread in a dry pan. Wash and slice tomato, then place on the toast.

name: Cheese Toast
steps: Place grated cheese on bread. Heat under a grill until melted, watching to prevent burning.

name: Banana Milk Smoothie
steps: Peel banana. Blend with milk until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Apple Banana Bowl
steps: Wash and chop the apple, removing the core. Peel and slice banana. Mix and serve.

name: Yoghurt Banana Bowl
steps: Peel and slice banana. Spoon yoghurt into a bowl and top with banana.

name: Carrot Apple Salad
steps: Wash the carrot and apple. Remove the apple core. Grate both ingredients and toss together.

name: Tomato Onion Salad
steps: Wash and slice tomatoes. Peel and thinly slice onion. Toss together and serve.

name: Butter Toast
steps: Toast bread in a dry pan or toaster. Spread with butter while warm.

name: Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread. Heat oil in a pan and fry the egg until white and yolk are set. Place on toast.

name: Mushroom Eggs
steps: Clean and slice mushrooms. Cook them in oil until softened. Beat and add eggs, stirring until fully set.

name: Pepper Onion Skillet
steps: Wash pepper and remove seeds. Slice pepper and peeled onion. Cook in oil until softened.

name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
steps: Wash cucumber and tomatoes. Slice both and toss together.

name: Milk Oats
steps: Combine oats and milk in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring, and cook until oats soften.

name: Banana Oats
steps: Simmer oats in milk, stirring until tender. Peel and slice banana and stir into the cooked oats.

name: Cheese Tomato Sandwich
steps: Wash and slice tomato. Layer cheese and tomato between the bread slices.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread. Spread peanut butter over it. Peel and slice banana and arrange on top.
